name: Farmer Maggot's Mushrooms
description: A basket of fat, white field mushrooms, the best in the Shire.

name: Potatoes
description: Good Bagshot Row potatoes. 'Taters, as the Gaffer says.

name: Farmhouse Cheese
description: A wedge of hard, sharp cheese from the Marish.

name: Jug of Cider
description: Cloudy apple cider from the Eastfarthing.

name: Elven Waybread
description: Thin cakes of fine white bread that fill the belly more than they seem to promise.

name: Elven Draught
description: A fragrant, cool, pale-gold drink in a small cup; it warms like wine and refreshes like spring water.

name: Longbottom Leaf
description: A pouch of fine pipe-weed from the Southfarthing.

name: Lobelia's Umbrella
description: A stout umbrella, much used for emphasis and occasionally for thumping.

name: Athelas
description: A pale, leafy weed that Rangers call kingsfoil; sweet and pungent when bruised.

name: Crickhollow Key
description: The front-door key of the new house at Crickhollow.

name: Bag End Key
description: The round green door's key. Frodo means to leave it for the Sackville-Bagginses.

name: Pouch of Salt
description: Sam's salt. 'Taters and rabbit want salt.

name: Cooking Gear
description: Pots and a pan, tied together with string.

name: Hooded Cloak
description: A weatherworn green-brown cloak, good for hiding in shadow.

name: Dried Meat
description: Strips of salted, smoked meat. Plain fare for the road.
